summary: S1 (per-event SMS lead-time reminders) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 8/8 passed: (a) persistence round-trip for competition booking_release_at + sms_reminder_offsets and flight booking sms_reminder_offsets, plus hotel/car default to []; (b) core.helpers.parse_local_datetime handles ISO (T/space/date-only), freeform DD-MM-YYYY & DD/MM/YYYY, returns None for garbage; (c) core.scheduler._valid_offsets keeps only {60,30,15,1} deduped desc; (d) send_timed_sms_tick fires ONE SMS when local now equals (booking_release_at - 60min), records dedupe row, and is a NO-OP on second run; the flight check-in path (depart_time - 24h - 15min) also fires+dedupes. send_sms was MONKEYPATCHED on both core.sms and core.scheduler — no real Twilio delivery occurred. Frontend Playwright verified: /competitions/new hides comp-sms-offset-* chips until booking_release_at is set (count=0), edit mode with stored [60,15] renders all 4 chips with 60 & 15 highlighted (bg=rgb(37,99,235)) and 30 & 1 unselected (bg=white); toggling 30 on then saving persists [60,30,15] on GET. /bookings/new shows flight-sms-offset-* only for type=flight (4 chips) and hides them for hotel & car (0 chips each). Original applereview notification_preferences restored after scheduler test.

critical_code_review_comments: core/scheduler.py:129-215 correctly computes local-now per user tz, walks booking + flight legs, uses a 0..120s tolerant window, and dedupes via sent_notifications keys `user:comp:{id}:booking_open:{off}` and `user:booking:{id}:checkin_{leg}:{off}` — verified idempotent across ticks.
core/scheduler.py:145-153 short-circuits when prefs.enabled=false OR sms_enabled=false OR sms_phone is missing/invalid — safe default.
routers/competitions.py:25 uses exclude_none=True so unset sms_reminder_offsets falls back to default_factory=list (default []) — GET always returns a list.
routers/bookings.py:30-31 explicitly coerces sms_reminder_offsets None→[] on create — hotel/car stay [] even if the client sends null.

core/helpers.parse_local_datetime is tolerant: ISO T/space/date-only, DD-MM-YYYY (with 4-digit last part) and DD/MM/YYYY via slash→dash normalization. Returns None on malformed months/days (verified via '2026-13-40').
SmsReminderPicker.tsx uses testID prefix pattern and Set-based toggle with descending sort — matches allowed offset order (60,30,15,1).
